stemMd: A section-drawing legend states that every solid region intersected by the cutting plane is hatched, and voids are unhatched. What does an unhatched enclosed opening in the section indicate?

options.label: B
options.textMd: A region with infinitely large thickness

options.label: C
options.textMd: A void rather than cut solid material

options.label: D
options.textMd: A measurement error in every case

options.label: E
options.textMd: A solid region cut by the plane

explanationMd: The legend assigns hatching to cut material. An enclosed area deliberately left unhatched can therefore show an opening or void; the interpretation follows the supplied convention.

distractorRationale.a: Hatching is not the scale indicator.
distractorRationale.e: That would be hatched under the stated convention.
distractorRationale.d: An opening can legitimately be unhatched.
